note: Warmup at the NEW operating point. At 142 steps, raising warmup 2->14 was worth -0.184 and was the single biggest schedule effect in campaign 1. At 568 steps the current 10% is 56 steps -- generous in absolute terms -- so the question flips: can I give steps BACK to peak LR? This halves it to 5% (28 steps).
